description: Binary assertions for /helix-concept-generate v3.1 multi-agent pipeline orchestration
test_input: generate concepts for VN-12.7MM-SIM recoil simulation system

assertions.name: pipeline_orchestration
assertions.check: output follows pipeline structure: invokes block-skills sequentially with CEO checkpoints

assertions.name: pipeline_state
assertions.check: output creates or references pipeline state file

assertions.name: block_preflight
assertions.check: output includes preflight verification (Phase 1 inputs, design type)

assertions.name: block_search
assertions.check: output includes solution search (morphological matrix with ACH column)

assertions.name: block_develop
assertions.check: output includes concept development (VDI 2225 with scores)

assertions.name: block_risk
assertions.check: output includes risk analysis (coupling + CFMA or sensitivity)

assertions.name: minimum_3_concepts
assertions.check: output generates at least 3 concept variants

assertions.name: ceo_checkpoint_pattern
assertions.check: output includes CEO checkpoint with approve/adjust/pause options

assertions.name: p02_qc_gate
assertions.check: output includes P02 QC gate before CEO selection
